ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r) · they agreed, conspired (3mp perfect, here of a wicked agreement)
ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct) · ለ- marking the object, doubling -ኦ on the verb (ቀተሎ ... ለንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'he killed him, the king of the Philistines')
ወበእንተሰ: በእንተ — and concerning indeed (ወ- + በእንተ + emphatic -ሰ)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
እምዘርአ: ዘርእ — from the seed of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
ወመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — and the kingdom (ወ- + noun; accusative)
እስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — Israel indeed (proper name + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
ተወልደት: ተወልደ — be born (3fs perfect, passive T stem)
እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
ኢተርእየ: ተርእየ — he was not seen, did not appear (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem, r-ʾ-y)
ወአንሶሰወ: አንሶሰወ — and it roamed, wandered about (ወ- + 3ms perfect, quadriliteral, n-s-s-w)
ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
ወመንክረ: መንክር — and marvel, wonder (ወ- + noun, accusative)
አንሥአ: አንሥአ — he raised up, lifted (3ms perfect, causative a-stem)
ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative) · transitive 'and he made shine' (ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and he made his face shine upon them')
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
መንፈሳዊያን: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
ወላዕለ: ላዕለ — and against (ወ- + preposition ላዕለ 'upon, over, against')
ወይኴንን: ኰነነ — and he judges (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ይኴንን)
ሕያዋነ: ሕያው — living ones (adjective used as noun, plural ሕያዋን, accusative)
ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
ወይፈድዮ: ፈደየ — and he repays (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G ይፈድይ + -ኦ '3ms him')
ለኵሉ: ኵሉ — to all, for everything · all, the whole (ለ- marking the object before a noun: ለኵሉ ዓለም 'the whole world', after ፈጠሮ 'he created it') · ለ- marking the object, 'everyone of' before ዘ- (ያወርዶ ለኵሉ ዘሥጋ 'brings down everyone of the flesh')
ሀለዎሙ: ሀለወ — it is for them, they must, are set to (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; impersonal) (?)
ለአይሁድ: አይሁድ — to the Jews (ለ- + plural noun) · ለ- marking the object (ያስተኀፍርዎሙ ለአይሁድ 'they shame the Jews')
ወይትኴነኑ: ተኰነነ — and they are judged, condemned (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, passive of ኰነነ 'judge, condemn'; written with ኴ)
ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
በርትዕት: ርቱዕ — in the right, orthodox (በ- + adjective, fem. ርትዕት)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
በፍኖተ: ፍኖት — on the path of (በ- 'on' + noun, construct state)
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
ሰቀሉ: ሰቀለ — they hanged, crucified (3mp perfect, G, s-q-l)
ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
ዝርዋነ: ዝርው — scattered, dispersed ones (adjective/participle of ዘርወ; plural accusative, predicate)
ወመንግሥቶሙ: መንግሥት — and their kingdom (ወ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
የዐቢ: ዐበየ — he is great, greater (3ms imperfect, G)
ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ለሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun, construct 'people of'; ለ- marks the object of the verb)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ያእምሩ: አእመረ — that they know, learn (3mp subjunctive, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
ጣዖቶሙ: ጣዖት — their idols (noun, collective singular + -ሙ '3mp their')
ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
ሕገ: ሕግ — law (accusative) · construct 'law of' (ሕገ መንግሥት 'the law of kingship')
ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
ለአማልክት: አምላክ — of the gods (ለ- + noun, plural አማልክት; after the construct ንጉሦሙ)
ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ይቤዝዎ: ቤዘወ — that he redeem him (3ms subjunctive, G, b-z-w + -ዎ '3ms him'; ለአዳም names the one redeemed)
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam')
በቅድሜሆሙ: ቅድሜ — before them (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
ኢትዮጵያሰ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia, as for Ethiopia (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for', contrastive)
በ፩: ፩ — on one; spoken በአሐዱ (bä-ʾäḥadu) 'in/on one' (በ- + numeral 1), በ፩ ገጽ 'on one side'
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
ነበብከ: ነበበ — you have spoken, said (G 2ms perf.)

እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. በእንቲአየ: በእንተ — about me, concerning me (preposition with the stem በእንቲአ- + -የ '1cs me')

ወጊሜ: ጊሜ — and gloom, mist, darkness (ወ- + noun)
